mentions.name: VerusCite
mentions.description: This app verifies citations in peer review journals, identifying when papers contain hallucinated (fabricated) references. It produces review results and offers sign-up with two free reviews.
mentions.problem: Papers can contain hallucinated (fabricated) references that go undetected during peer review.
mentions.audience: Papers can contain hallucinated (fabricated) references that go undetected during peer review.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An app to verify citations in peer review journals, https://veruscite-data.com

that is, to identify when papers have hallucinated references
mentions.author: apwheele
